# telnyx_rcs_brand (Resource)

An RCS brand, the verified business under which RCS agents are registered. The API cannot delete brands, so destroy only removes the brand from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The API cannot delete RCS brands, so destroy only removes the brand from
# Terraform state.
resource "telnyx_rcs_brand" "acme" {
  display_name      = "Acme"
  legal_name        = "Acme Inc."
  legal_entity_type = "CORPORATION"
  organization_type = "PRIVATE_PROFIT"
  website_url       = "https://acme.example.com"
  profile_id        = telnyx_messaging_profile.support.id

  addresses = jsonencode({
    headquarters = {
      line_1              = "600 Congress Avenue"
      city                = "Austin"
      administrative_area = "TX"
      postal_code         = "78701"
      country_code        = "US"
    }
  })

  contacts = {
    brand = {
      contact_type = "BRAND"
      first_name   = "Jane"
      last_name    = "Doe"
      email        = "jane.doe@acme.example.com"
      phone_number = "+15125550100"
    }
  }

  identifiers = {
    ein = {
      identifier_type = "EIN"
      value           = "12-3456789"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addresses` (String) The business addresses. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `contacts` (Attributes) Named business contacts. Use the `brand` key for the required BRAND contact. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))
- `display_name` (String) The brand name shown to recipients.
- `identifiers` (Attributes) Named business identifiers. Use the `ein` key for the required EIN and `stock_symbol` for a public-profit brand's stock symbol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identifiers))
- `legal_entity_type` (String) The legal form of the business. One of `CORPORATION`, `LIMITED_LIABILITY_COMPANY`, `PARTNERSHIP`, `SOLE_PROPRIETORSHIP`, `S_CORPORATION`.
- `legal_name` (String) The legal name of the business.
- `organization_type` (String) The kind of organization. One of `GOVERNMENT`, `NON_PROFIT`, `PRIVATE_PROFIT`, `PUBLIC_PROFIT`, `UNKNOWN`.
- `website_url` (String) The business website.

### Optional

- `profile_id` (String) A Messaging Profile owned by the authenticated organization. Agents inherit this value when they do not provide their own profile.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Attributes) What the brand's registration path supports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `id` (String) Identifies the RCS brand.
- `status` (String) The verification state of the brand.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_rcs_brand.acme <id>
```
